name: data_profiling
description: TypeScript library for DuckDB data profiling

scripts.pretest: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('.test-dist', {recursive: true, force: true})"
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-dist/tests/*.test.js .test-dist/tests/metrics/*.test.js
